target_right_vs_future_rightward_motion.description: Target lateral coordinate vs rightward displacement over ~1s using CARLA right_vector; lookahead mismatch may weaken correlation.

limits: CARLA raw yaw is in degrees. CARLA positive yaw/steer conventions differ from MetaDrive; do not infer sign by comparing yaw numbers alone.
A 1-second motion does not necessarily follow a 25m waypoint on curved roads.
Vehicle lane changes, braking and route plans confound raw correlations.
Action labels are from original PDD controls; frame/control synchronization is still a statistical candidate.
